options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: interface_name
options.description: Set interface name. Select the LAN interface to be configured.

options.name: ipv6_address
options.description: If DHCP is disabled, specify a static IPv6 address to be configured for the selected interface. Required when I(ipv6_dhcp_enable=static).

options.name: ipv6_dhcp_enable
options.description: Enable 'Enable DHCP' to dynamically configure IPv6 address using Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP).

options.name: ipv6_gateway
options.description: If DHCP is disabled, specify a static Default Gateway to be configured for the selected interface. Required when I(ipv6_dhcp_enable=static).

options.name: ipv6_prefix
options.description: The subnet prefix length for the IPv6 settings(0-128). Required when I(ipv6_dhcp_enable=static).

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
